source: Supabase Security Advisor + read-only SQL audit

findings.name: Supabase · pg_net schema
findings.detail: pg_net 0.20.4 is installed in public and extrelocatable=false. A direct schema move is not a safe one-line repair.
findings.gate: Owner approval required before any extension or dependency change

findings.name: Supabase · SECURITY DEFINER RPC surface
findings.detail: Security Advisor reports 8 SECURITY DEFINER functions executable by authenticated users. Read-only review found auth/ownership/admin guards on the reviewed RPCs, but the privileged surface still requires function-by-function hardening.
findings.evidence: Advisor count=8 · anon EXECUTE=false on reviewed functions · authenticated EXECUTE=true
findings.gate: No blind revoke or invoker switch; regression-test each RPC before change

findings.name: Supabase · Leaked Password Protection
findings.detail: Leaked password protection is disabled. This is an Auth policy setting, not a storefront code fix.
findings.gate: Owner-gated Auth policy change after login-impact review
